study: Stage C: matched planner controls (review E1) and freshness-window sensitivity (review E3)

method_definitions.JLC-R: frozen RC2 controller unchanged; fresh replication arm serving as reproduction check and planner-timing baseline
method_definitions.SIMPLE-MATCHED-PLANNER: stage-1 budget replaced by a one-shot proportional rule on the point forecast: scale_i=clip(((battery_i-reserve)/horizon_days+point_day_i)/(full_slot_obligation_i),0,1); no bisection, no scenario stress; slot quantisation, credit-floor formula, stage-2 prefix-credit solver, cadence, queue, holds, Guard and recovery unchanged; floor shortfalls counted not repaired, and for this arm only the FDC re-plan floor assertion (which fires after its state updates) is downgraded to a counter
method_definitions.POINT-PLANNER: identical to JLC-R except every planning-time scenario risk path is replaced by the point path (bank view proxy); isolates scenario robustness

e3.override: sim.c[deadline_rounds] set after construction; period_rounds and cadence untouched

planned_statistics: reproduction check: stage C JLC-R vs stage B JLC-R per (seed,cell) metric equality
paired deltas SMP/PP minus JLC-R on coverage_pct, source_coverage_p5_pct, demand_delivery_pct, sample_completion_pct, consumed_j
equal-condition means (unweighted mean of the 8 cell means) and per-cell means
seed-level paired t intervals (nominal, descriptive) and the same deltas against NO-JOINT-PADC from stage B
planner wall time per call and per run by arm
E3: coverage and Source P5 by D in {2,4,8} x method x weather cell at supply 1.0 (D=4 from stage B and stage C e1)
